description: FER_4_2_9_VULCANI is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.regione.sardegna.it. Identification of the polygons that represent the perimeter of the volcanic apparatuses. The data is indicative and has reconnaissance and advisory value and in no case to be used for legal purposes. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Vulcani, apparati vulcanici, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
